title: IaC preflight health prober and rollout safety harness for Private/VPC
creator: Asha Kapoor
description:
Motivation: Private (VPC) customers expect automated, safe infrastructure changes with deterministic preflight checks and graduated rollouts. Current TF pipelines run plan/apply but lack a standardized preflight health validator and an automated canary/rollback harness tied to policy-as-code. This ticket implements a reusable 'preflight health prober' and a 'rollout safety harness' that integrate with our TF CI (GitHub Actions + Terraform Cloud) and OPA/Conftest policy checks.

Scope:
- Preflight validator that runs on PRs and orchestration pipelines: tffmt/tflint, terraform plan, tfsec/checkov, plus Conftest (OPA) policy evaluation on the plan JSON.
- Health prober that can instantiate an ephemeral minimal stack (sandbox account/workspace) or evaluate live drift-free probes against a target VPC: network reachability, route table sanity, subnets allocation, KMS key policy, and a small app-level probe (HTTP + warm KV cache) to confirm runtime viability.
- Rollout safety harness implemented as Terraform Cloud run-level orchestration plus a companion GitHub Action: staged apply (canary subset), automated probe post-apply, automatic rollback/apply reversion on failure, and human-in-loop approval for escalations.
- Policy gating: failing OPA rules block merges and plan promotion unless explicit security exceptions are recorded. Policy scoring/metadata should be surfaced in the plan comment on the PR.
- Observability: emit prober run results to Ops metrics (Prometheus/Datadog), store plan+policy artifacts in S3 for audit, and add a simple dashboard (Console link) for recent preflight runs and canary health history.

Non-goals: full drift remediation automation, replacing Terraform Cloud’s RBAC, or creating new cloud-native operator for customers. We will reuse existing TF modules and workspaces where possible.
acceptance_criteria: PR pipeline invokes tffmt/tflint + terraform plan and uploads plan JSON for Conftest (OPA) evaluation; any policy FAIL blocks merge.

Preflight health prober can run against a sandbox workspace and returns a machine-readable pass/fail JSON containing checks for CIDR conflicts, subnet reachability, Security Group rules, route table coverage, and KMS key presence.

Terraform Cloud orchestrated canary apply: workspace accepts 'canary' tag to limit apply to one target pool; post-apply prober runs automatically and marks the run success/failure. Failed canary triggers rollback and opens an incident MR with logs.
Policy evaluation summary (policy score, top-3 failing rules, and remediation hints) is posted as a comment on the PR and persisted to the artifact bucket for audits.
Prober metrics are emitted to Datadog with tags (workspace, team, canary=true/false, policy_score) and dashboard shows trend for last 90 days.
End-to-end tests: runbook exercise completes (create PR, policy fails, fix, merge, canary apply passes, promote to full rollout).
notes: 2025-02-12: Initial spec drafted (Asha). Key design call: prefer plan-time Conftest with OPA versus post-apply analysis to fail fast and avoid costly rollbacks.

2025-02-18: Design review with Security and Platform (Maya Chen, Diego Alvarez). Agreed: OPA policy library will live in infra-policy repo; prober will run in an ephemeral sandbox TFC workspace using a short-lived KMS key.
2025-02-22: Decided to implement canary by leveraging workspace variables (apply_targets) and tagging; avoid branching on cloud provider APIs to keep logic in TF where possible. (Liam)
2025-02-26: Proof-of-concept running Conftest on plan JSON completed. Sample PR comment produced with policy score and top5 failing rules. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/3145

2025-03-01: Security review flagged KMS policy handling as high risk if we permit write access during ephemeral provisioning. Action: use customer-managed encryption keys only with scoped IAM roles; secrets pulled from Vault with short TTL. (Security ticket created: ENG-76890)

2025-03-03: Implemented basic health prober checks (CIDR overlap, subnet mask sanity, SG open ports). Integration tests in sandbox passed for aws-private-vpc module. Test runs logged to S3 bucket: s3://redwood-infra-preflight/runs/2025-03-03-pp-001.json

2025-03-05: Blocker: Terraform Cloud API rate-limits causing delayed run status updates when running 50+ parallel canaries. Mitigation options: add exponential backoff and batching; we may need a pacing controller. Assigned to Diego to prototype (ENG-76350).
implementation_notes: We will add a GitHub Action job 'preflight-checks' that: 1) runs tflint/tfmt, 2) terraform init/plan -out=plan.binary, 3) terraform show -json plan.binary > plan.json, 4) run conftest test plan.json --policy infra-policy/, 5) upload plan.json + conftest report to S3 and post policy summary as a PR comment via the checks API. For canary applies: a Terraform Cloud run hook triggers the health-prober service (lambda container) to execute probes and call TFC run/force-run to continue or queue an apply rollback. Logs persisted and linked in run notes.
